summary: Two qualifying Raleigh retail refinance leads out of 21 base records. Applying the 2026-08-31 cutoff (evidence must be published and effective on or before it), executed-document overrides, and the requirement for a record owner plus a current CFO / Head of Acquisitions / Director of Finance each verified since 2026-03-01, only Elm Square 1 (ELM-REF-63521, maturity 2027-01-15, $8,640,000 original principal) and Elm Point 3 (ELM-REF-53828, maturity 2027-03-15, $9,936,000 original principal) qualify. R4437 is a second source on the same underlying Elm Square 1 record and is deduplicated into R6968 rather than taking a second sponsor slot. Four records were knocked out by executed amendments reclassifying the asset to Office (R5893, R3478, R9233, R2630); one by an executed extension moving maturity to 2028-09-30 (R1927); others by released/unknown loan status, unconfirmed or inferred maturity, unresolved extension option, stale ownership verification, non-owner/registered-agent or former contacts, out-of-market/asset-type, out-of-window maturity, or post-cutoff publication. Outstanding balances are unknown in every extract (loan amounts are original principal only) and are reported null, not zero. Emails are reported only where published.

limitations: Outstanding balance is not published in any extract; all loan_amount_usd values are original_principal and outstanding_balance_usd is reported null (unknown, not zero).

R7631 (Elm Point 3) has a recorded release U-R7631-2 published/effective 2026-09-10, i.e. after the 2026-08-31 cutoff. Under the as-of-cutoff rule it does not control, but the loan is very likely paid off in reality; re-verify before outreach.
R7798 (Elm Crossing 18) may be a valid lead but its only evidence is published 2026-09-03, after the cutoff, so it could not be assessed on-cutoff.
Duplicate handling assumes R6968 and R4437 describe one property/loan (identical entity_id, owner_entity_id, loan_id, amount and maturity); only one sponsor slot was used.
No independent confirmation of lender, current interest rate, amortization, prepayment terms, occupancy or NOI; refinance sizing cannot be assessed from these extracts.
Contact emails rely solely on 'published_business' basis in the base extracts; no enrichment or verification was performed, and R3478's email is explicitly not published.

Only executed amendments, recorded releases and current team-page updates supplied in the packet were applied; unsigned draft U-R9233-3 was disregarded, and no other extensions or releases can be ruled out from the given evidence.
